headline: Bank of Canada Weighs Inflation and Growth Ahead of Rate Decision
summary: Markets price an 80% chance of a rate hike to 2.50% as the Bank of Canada weighs 3.1% inflation against weak growth and trade uncertainty.
why: Central bank interest rate decisions dictate domestic borrowing costs and shape foreign exchange rates for the Canadian dollar.

impacts.name: Canada
impacts.why: Potential rate hikes increase debt servicing costs for households and businesses while aiming to cool 3.1% inflation.

why_moved: Priced expectations of a rate hike to 2.50% in the face of stubborn inflation drive positioning in Canadian fixed-income and currency markets.
